video.title: I cleared 4,212 unread emails in 30 seconds
video.hook: A phone screen shows an inbox counter reading 4,212 unread, and the number starts dropping fast while a voice says: "watch this".
video.description: Opens on an inbox counter reading 4,212 unread that starts dropping fast. The founder's voiceover shows the AI tool sorting mail, drafting replies and archiving newsletters, with big on-screen captions. Ends on 'Inbox: 0' and a 'link in bio'.
